DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届けたい物をお持ちなのですね。何を、どちらで拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have something to hand in. What did you find, and where?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 黒いスマートフォンです。公園の南側の入り口で拾ったと思い、こちらに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 黒いスマートフォンを拾い公園南側入口だと思って届けたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A black smartphone. I brought it here thinking I found it at the park's south entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you found a black smartphone and brought it in believing the location was the park's south entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所をこの見取図で示していただけますか。入口が二つあるので、目印も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show the location on this sketch? There are two entrances, so please give a landmark too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水飲み場の横です。図を見ると北側でした。すみません、最初に南側と言ったのを訂正してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見取図と水飲み場から北側と気づき南側という最初の説明を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside the drinking fountain. Looking at the sketch, it was the north side. Sorry, please correct my initial statement that it was the south side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, use the sketch and fountain to recognize the north side and correct your initial south-side explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 北側の水飲み場付近に訂正します。拾った時刻と、その後に端末を操作したかも伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll correct it to near the north-side fountain. I'll also ask when you found it and whether you operated the device afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の昼過ぎ、一時十分ごろです。画面が点きましたが、ロックを解除したり通知を開いたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日一時十分ごろ拾い点灯はしたが解除や通知閲覧はしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just after noon today, around one ten. The screen lit up, but I didn't unlock it or open any notifications.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you found it around one ten today and the screen lit up, but you did not unlock it or view notifications.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままお持ちになったのですね。端末以外に、一緒に落ちていたものはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you brought it as it was. Was anything else lying with it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そばに青い布袋がありました。ただ、同じ人の物かはわからないので、端末とは別々に持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い布袋も近くにあったが同じ所有者か不明なので別々に持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was a blue cloth bag nearby. But I don't know whether it belongs to the same person, so I brought it separately from the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say a blue cloth bag was nearby, but you brought it separately because the common owner is unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 関連は未確認として、二つとも場所と状況を記録します。連絡先の記入と、この後の手続きについてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll leave the connection unconfirmed and record the location and circumstances for both. I'll explain contact details and the next procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから記入します。控えにも、端末と布袋の二つを届けたことが載っているか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手続き説明後に記入すると答え控えの品目に端末と布袋の二点が載るか確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll fill it in after hearing the explanation. I'd also like to check that the receipt lists both the device and cloth bag I handed in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will fill in details after the procedure explanation and want to check that the receipt lists both the device and cloth bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録する品目を一緒に確認しましょう。お届けいただいた物はこちらでお預かりします。ご協力ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the recorded items together. We'll take care of the things you've handed in. Thank you for cooperating. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に伴う郵便のご相談ですね。同じ住所にお住まいの方は、皆さん一緒に移られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about mail after moving. Is everyone at the same address moving together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は先に引っ越しましたが、妹は来月まで前の家に残ります。二人を同じ日に転居したことにしてよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人は転居済みで妹は来月まで旧居に残ると説明し同じ転居日にしてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved first, but my younger sister stays at the old home until next month. May I put the same moving date for both of us?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you have moved but your younger sister stays until next month, and ask whether you may use the same moving date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際と異なる日付は書かず、お二人の状況を分けて確認しましょう。ご本人だけ先に手続きを進めたいというご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't write a date different from reality; let's check your two situations separately. Would you like to proceed for yourself first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まず私の分を相談したいです。妹の名前まで書きかけたので、この欄を訂正する方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まず自分の分を進めたいと伝え書きかけた妹の名前の訂正方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I'd like to discuss only mine first. I started writing my sister's name too, so please explain how to correct this field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you want to proceed for yourself first and ask how to correct the sister's name you started writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ提出前ですね。書き直すための用紙をお渡しします。本人確認や住所の確認に必要な書類についても、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It hasn't been submitted yet. I'll give you a fresh form. I'll also explain documents needed to verify your identity and address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新住所が載った書類は持っています。以前の住所は建物名が長いのですが、省略せずに書く場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所の書類があると述べ長い旧住所の建物名を省略せず書く場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have documents showing the new address. The old building name is long; is there somewhere to write it without abbreviation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you have new-address documents and ask where to write the long old building name without shortening it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 欄に収まりにくければ、記入する前に職員に見せてください。部屋番号なども含めて確認します。妹さんの分は転居時期に合わせて別途ご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If it doesn't fit easily, show staff before filling it in. We'll check the room number and other details too. Ask separately about your sister when she moves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 妹には別に確認するよう伝えます。私の申込みを今日出せば、明日からすべて新居へ届くと考えていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 妹には別途相談を伝えると答え本日申込みで翌日から全部転送されるのか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my sister to check separately. If I submit my application today, may I assume everything will reach the new home starting tomorrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will tell your sister to consult separately and check whether applying today means all mail is forwarded from tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 翌日からすべて届くとはお約束できません。反映までの案内と対象外となる郵便物なども確認が必要です。大事な差出人には、住所変更を直接お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can't promise all mail will arrive from tomorrow. The implementation period and excluded mail also need checking. Tell important senders your new address directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: すぐ全部転送されるとは考えず、勤務先へ新住所を知らせます。今日は自分の用紙だけ書き直し、提出前に見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 即時全面転送とは考えず勤務先へ住所を通知し自分の用紙のみ書き直して提出前確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume everything is forwarded immediately, and will tell my employer the new address. Today I'll rewrite only my own form and have it checked before submitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, avoid assuming immediate full forwarding, notify your employer of the address, and request checking of only your rewritten form before submission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらが新しい用紙と案内です。書けたら窓口へお戻りください。本日のご説明は以上です。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the new form and instructions. Return to the counter once it's filled in. That's all today's explanation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更の途中で止まってしまったのですね。どの画面まで進めましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You got stuck during the address change. Which screen did you reach?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 認証コードを送る画面です。表示されたのが解約した携帯番号なので、受け取れず先へ進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 解約した旧携帯番号に認証コードが送られるため進めないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen to send a verification code. The displayed mobile number has been canceled, so I can't receive it or continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you can't proceed because the verification code goes to a canceled old mobile number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 旧番号のままなのですね。認証を省略することはできません。住所と連絡先を変更するため、窓口で必要な本人確認をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The old number is still registered. We can't skip authentication. We'll explain the identification needed at the counter to change the address and contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人確認をお願いします。新住所の記載された書類と、口座のカードはこちらです。新しい電話番号も一緒に届けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新住所記載の本人確認書類と口座カードを示し新電話番号も届けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please verify my identity. Here are my identity document showing the new address and account card. I'd also like to register the new phone number together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show your new-address identification and account card, and say you want to register the new phone number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書類を確認します。住所の部屋番号が少し読み取りにくいので、口頭でも教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the documents. The room number is a little hard to read; could you tell me aloud too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五〇二号室です。五〇三ではありません。郵便物が別の部屋へ届かないよう、申請内容も五〇二にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号は五〇三でなく五〇二であり申請も五〇二にするよう明確に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Room five zero two, not five zero three. Put five zero two on the application too so mail doesn't go to another room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, clearly say the room is five zero two, not five zero three, and request five zero two on the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 五〇二号室と確認しました。入力内容をご本人にも確認していただきます。なお、すでに発送準備に入った郵便物は、新住所に切り替わらない場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Confirmed, room five zero two. You'll check the entered details too. Mail already being prepared for dispatch may not switch to the new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ旧住所へ届く可能性があるのですね。発送予定の通知があるかも、この窓口で調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所へ届く可能性を確認し発送予定通知の情報を窓口で調べられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So it may still reach the old address. Can this counter also check whether any notices are scheduled for sending?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, confirm the possibility of old-address delivery and ask whether the counter can check scheduled notices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人確認の後に、こちらで確認できる発送情報をお調べします。すべての送付物について、行き先変更が間に合うとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After identity verification, we'll check the dispatch information available here. We can't promise that redirection will be in time for every item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更が間に合うかは確認後に判断するのですね。まず新住所、五〇二号室、新しい携帯番号を申請書で照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送付先変更の可否は確認後と理解し新住所と五〇二号室と新携帯番号を申請書で照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Whether a destination change can be made in time will be determined after checking. First I'll compare the new address, room five zero two and new mobile number on the application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, acknowledge that redirection depends on checking, and say you will compare the new address, room five zero two and new mobile number on the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、この確認欄をご覧ください。照合後に受付手順を進めます。本日のご案内は以上です。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, look at this confirmation field. After comparison we'll proceed with acceptance. That's all today's guidance. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのソースの表示で、読みにくいところはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything hard to read on that sauce label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表には常温保存とありますが、裏には冷蔵とも書いてあります。同じ瓶なのに、どちらに従えばよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じソース瓶の常温と冷蔵という表示の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The front says room-temperature storage but the back says refrigerated. Which should I follow for the same bottle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask about the difference between room-temperature and refrigerated instructions on the same sauce bottle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 裏の冷蔵という表示は、開封後について書かれています。未開封と開封後で条件が違う商品ですね。いつ使われるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The refrigeration instruction on the back is for after opening. This product has different conditions unopened and opened. When do you plan to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今夜少しだけ使い、残りは何週間かかけて使うつもりでした。開けた後も、この賞味期限まで置いていいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数週間かけて使いたいと伝え開封後も印字の賞味期限まで保存できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: A little tonight, then the rest over several weeks. After opening, can I keep it until this printed best-before date too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you want to use it over several weeks and ask whether the printed best-before date also applies after opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この期限は未開封で表示どおりに保存した場合のものです。開封後は冷蔵し早めに使うとあり、具体的な日数はここにはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That date applies unopened and stored as directed. After opening it says refrigerate and use soon; no specific number of days is written here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使い切れるか判断できないので、この大瓶はやめます。一回分ずつ開けられる小袋の商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使い切れるか判断できないため大瓶を断り一回分ずつ開ける小袋商品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can't judge whether I'll finish it, so I'll leave the large bottle. Do you have small sachets that can each be opened for one use?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, decline the large bottle because you can't judge whether you'll finish it, and ask for individually opened single-use sachets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは小袋四つ入りです。外袋に原材料と保存方法が載っています。小袋を開けた後は一度で使い切る表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one contains four sachets. Ingredients and storage instructions are on the outer bag. It says to use an opened sachet all at once.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度で使い切る小袋のほうにします。にんにくの香りが苦手なので、原材料欄に入っているか一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小袋を選ぶ意向とにんにくの香りが苦手なことを伝え原材料への記載を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose the sachets used all at once. I dislike garlic's smell; could you help check whether it's listed in the ingredients?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you intend to choose sachets and dislike garlic's smell, then check whether garlic is listed in the ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この商品の原材料欄には、にんにくと記載されています。隣の別商品についても、表示を確認してから選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This product's ingredient list includes garlic. You can check the neighboring product's label too before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、今の商品も買わず、隣の表示を自分でも読みます。原材料と小分けの条件が合うものを選んでから、レジへ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今の商品は買わず隣の原材料と小分け条件を確認してから会計へ進むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I won't buy this one either, and will read the neighboring label myself. I'll choose something matching the ingredients and portion conditions before taking it to the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you won't buy this product, will check the neighboring ingredients and portion conditions, then proceed to checkout after choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ごゆっくりお選びください。大瓶はこちらで棚へ戻します。お手伝いはここまででよろしいですね。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time choosing. I'll return the large bottle to the shelf. That's all the help you need for now, right? Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その先の小橋は点検で通れません。どちらへ向かわれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The small bridge ahead is closed for inspection. Where are you headed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩き始めた東の入口へ戻りたいです。この橋を渡らずに戻れる道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入園した東入口へ戻りたいと伝え閉鎖中の橋を渡らない経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to return to the east entrance where I began walking. Please tell me a way back without crossing this bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you want to return to the east entrance you entered through and ask for a route avoiding the closed bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池の反対側を回る園路なら戻れます。上り坂の近道と、平らな回り道があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can return via the park path around the other side of the pond. There's an uphill shortcut and a level detour.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 膝に負担をかけたくないので、遠くても平らな道にします。入口までに腰掛けられる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 膝のため遠くても平らな道を選び途中の腰掛け場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't want to strain my knees, so I'll take the level path even if farther. Is there somewhere to sit before reaching the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, choose the level path even if farther for your knees, and ask for seating along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中の休憩広場にベンチがあります。ただ、今は一つを塗り直していて、そのベンチには座れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are benches in the rest square on the way. But one is being repainted now, and you can't sit on that one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使用中止の表示があるベンチは避けます。休憩広場へ行く分かれ道で、見落としにくい目印は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用中止ベンチを避けると述べ休憩広場への分岐の見つけやすい目印を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll avoid benches marked out of use. What's an easy-to-spot landmark at the junction toward the rest square?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will avoid the out-of-use bench and ask for a noticeable landmark at the rest-square junction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きな丸い花壇が目印です。そこで池を左手に見る向きへ曲がると、休憩広場に着きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: A large round flower bed is the landmark. Turn there so the pond is on your left, and you'll reach the rest square.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸い花壇で池を左側にするのですね。広場から先も同じ園路を進めば、東の入口に戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 丸い花壇で池を左にする向きを確認し広場の先の園路から東入口へ戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the round flower bed, I turn with the pond to my left. After the square, can I return to the east entrance by continuing on the same park path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, confirm the direction with the pond on your left at the round flower bed, and ask whether the path beyond the square returns to the east entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、広場の先では「東入口」の表示に沿ってください。小橋のほうへ折り返す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Beyond the square, follow the east-entrance signs. You don't need to turn back toward the small bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 平らな園路で広場へ行き、使えるベンチで休んでから東入口の表示をたどります。橋へは戻りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 平らな園路と使用可能ベンチと東入口表示を使い閉鎖橋へ戻らない経路を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the level park path to the square, rest on a usable bench, and follow the east-entrance signs. I won't go back to the bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, repeat the route using the level path, usable bench and east-entrance signs, without returning to the closed bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その道順です。案内図の東入口に丸を付けておきます。どうぞお持ちください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's the route. I'll circle the east entrance on the map. Please take it, and have a safe return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車場所をお探しですか。こちらの階段の先が乗り場ですが、荷物が大きいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the boarding area? It's up these stairs, but your luggage is large.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このかばんを持って階段を上るのは難しいです。段差の少ない行き方を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重いかばんで階段を使うのが難しいため段差の少ない経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's difficult to carry this bag up the stairs. Could you tell me a route with fewer steps?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask for a route with fewer steps because the heavy bag makes stairs difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正面の通路を回ると、階段を使わず乗り場へ行けます。お乗りになる便の表示を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you go around through the corridor ahead, you can reach the boarding area without stairs. Please show the service you're taking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約の画面はこちらです。二番乗り場とありますが、その通路から二番まで行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約画面を提示して迂回通路から二番乗り場へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's my reservation screen. It says boarding area two; can I reach number two through that corridor?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show your reservation screen and ask whether the detour corridor reaches boarding area two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。通路を出たら二番の表示が見えます。発車までは二十分ありますので、途中の待合室も使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You'll see the number-two sign when you leave the corridor. There's twenty minutes until departure, so you can use the waiting room along the way too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に待合室でかばんの中を整理したいです。そこで乗車開始の案内も聞こえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待合室で荷物を整理したいと伝え乗車案内が聞こえるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to organize the bag in the waiting room first. Can I hear the boarding announcement there too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you want to organize your luggage in the waiting room and confirm that boarding announcements can be heard there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 室内にも放送は流れますが、聞き取れなければ表示板を確かめてください。大きいかばんは荷物室を利用する場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Announcements play inside too, but check the display if you can't catch them. Large bags may need to go in the luggage compartment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物室に預ける前に、薬と財布を手元の袋へ移します。かばんを預ける場所は運転手に聞けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬と財布を取り出すと伝え荷物を預ける場所の相談先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before handing it over, I'll move my medicine and wallet into the bag I keep with me. Should I ask the driver where to hand in the suitcase?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will take out your medicine and wallet, then ask whom to consult about where to hand in the luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二番の乗車担当にお尋ねください。荷物の大きさによって扱いを確認しますので、ご自身で荷物室を開けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask the boarding staff at number two. They'll check handling according to size; don't open the luggage compartment yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待合室で薬と財布を取り出し、二番の担当者にかばんの扱いを確認してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物整理の後で二番の担当者に預け方を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take out my medicine and wallet in the waiting room, ask number-two staff about handling the case, and then board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will organize your luggage and then check with number-two staff how to hand it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。この通路をまっすぐお進みください。乗車場所までお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Go straight down this corridor. Take care on the way to the boarding area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談でしたら、記入する前に新しい住所を確認します。住所が分かるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: For moving-in procedures, we'll check the new address before you fill anything in. Do you have something showing it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸契約書を持ってきました。ただ、契約書と建物の入口で名前が少し違い、どちらを書くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約書を提示し入口表示と建物名が違って記入に迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought the rental contract. But the building name differs a little between it and the entrance sign, so I'm unsure which to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show the contract and say you are unsure which building name to write because the entrance sign differs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 違う部分を示していただけますか。部屋番号も含めて、担当者が照合できるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you point out the difference? We'll make it possible for the staff to compare the room number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書は「南風ハイツ」、入口は「みなみかぜ」です。部屋番号はどちらも二〇三です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書と入口の異なる建物名および共通の部屋番号を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The contract says ‘南風ハイツ,’ and the entrance says ‘みなみかぜ.’ Both have room two zero three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show the different building names on the contract and entrance and the shared room number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表記の違いですね。こちらでは正式な表記を決められないため、その点を住所の担当へ引き継ぎます。入居日は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: A difference in written form. We can't decide the official form here, so we'll pass it to the address staff. Do you know your move-in date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入居したのは今月十日です。契約の開始日は一日なので、実際に住み始めた十日と伝えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入居日と契約開始日を区別して伝え記入する日付を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I moved in on the tenth of this month. The contract starts on the first, so should I say the tenth when I actually began living there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, distinguish move-in and contract-start dates and ask which date to write.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの日付を分けて担当者にお伝えください。どの欄に記入するかは、書類を見ながら確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the staff the two dates separately. We'll check the fields while looking at your documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開始日が一日、住み始めた日が十日とメモします。間違えたくないので、その欄はまだ空けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二つの日付をメモして該当欄を未記入にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note contract start on the first and residence start on the tenth. I don't want a mistake, so I'll leave that field blank for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will note the two dates and leave the relevant field unfilled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それで結構です。契約書の原本とメモはご自身でお持ちのまま、右の相談席へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine. Keep the original contract and notes with you and go to the consultation seats on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 契約書とメモを持って相談席へ行き、建物名と日付を確認してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 契約書とメモを携えて住所担当に確認してから記入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the contract and notes to the consultation seat and fill it in after checking the building name and dates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, decide to bring your contract and notes and fill in the form after checking with the address staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者に確認したい点を伝えました。順番にお呼びしますので、相談席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've told the staff what you want to check. We'll call in order, so wait in the consultation seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のことでお困りですか。予約を変更する場合は、担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with an appointment? For changes, I'll connect you with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週火曜の九時に予約していますが、送ってくれる人が午前中に来られなくなりました。午後へ変更を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 火曜九時の受診に送迎が間に合わず午後への変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm booked for nine next Tuesday, but the person driving me can't come in the morning now. I'd like to ask about changing to the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that your ride cannot make Tuesday's nine-o'clock appointment and request an afternoon change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票を見せてください。午後を希望されるのは、同じ火曜日でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show the appointment slip. Do you mean the afternoon of that same Tuesday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この予約票の火曜日です。付き添いが必要なので、一人で来る時間帯には変えたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約票を見せ同じ火曜で付き添いと来られる時間にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this Tuesday on the slip. I need someone with me and don't want to change to a time when I'd come alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show the slip and request the same Tuesday at a time you can attend with your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 付き添いの方が来られる時間を、予約担当へ伝えます。何時以降なら一緒に来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the booking staff when your companion can come. From what time can you attend together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十四時以降なら付き添ってもらえます。担当の先生も同じ方を希望すると伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十四時以降と同じ担当医を希望条件として取り次いでもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: From fourteen hundred onward. Please tell them I'd also prefer the same doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, have the staff relay your preferences for fourteen hundred or later and the same doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件で確認を依頼します。今ここで空きを確約することはできません。折り返しの連絡を受けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll request a check under those conditions. We can't promise a slot here now. Can you take a callback?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の十七時までなら電話に出られます。知らない番号を拒否する設定を解除しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十七時まで電話対応可能と伝え着信拒否を解除する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can answer until seventeen hundred today. I'll turn off the setting that blocks unknown numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you can answer until seventeen hundred and will turn off unknown-number blocking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡先はこちらの番号でよろしいですね。変更が決まるまでは、元の予約は取り消していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the correct contact number, right? Until a change is decided, the original appointment hasn't been canceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号に間違いありません。今の九時の予約は残ったままと理解し、折り返しの電話で変更結果を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を確認し元の予約は残っていると理解して変更結果を電話で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The number is correct. I understand the current nine-o'clock appointment remains, and will confirm the change result on the callback.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, confirm your contact details, understand that the original appointment remains, and check the change result by phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 希望と連絡可能な時間を担当へ伝えます。予約が確定したか、連絡の際に必ずお確かめください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your wishes and availability to the staff. Make sure during the call whether the appointment has been confirmed. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないのですね。ご自分の物か、借りた物かを先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing. First, is it your own or borrowed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宿で借りた自転車です。買い物から戻ったらなく、同じ色の別の自転車が一台ありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿の借用自転車がなくなり同色の別車体が残っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Borrowed from my lodging. It was gone when I returned from shopping, and another bicycle of the same color was there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say the lodging's borrowed bicycle disappeared and a different same-colored bicycle remained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 似ていても、別の物には触らないでください。最後に止めた時刻と場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even if similar, don't touch someone else's bicycle. Do you know when and where you last parked it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の十一時ごろ、店の自転車置き場のいちばん奥に止めました。店には移動していないと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十一時ごろ店の駐輪場所奥に止め店には移動していないと確認済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around eleven today, at the very back of the shop's bicycle parking. The shop told me they hadn't moved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you parked at the back of the shop's bicycle area around eleven and already confirmed the shop did not move it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お店への確認は済んでいるのですね。借りた車体を見分ける番号や写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You've checked with the shop, then. Do you have a number or photo identifying the borrowed bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発前の写真があります。青い車体に「貸出七」と札が付き、前かごの右側が少し曲がっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真と青い色や貸出七の札および曲がったかごを識別情報として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: A photo from before setting off. It's blue with a tag saying ‘Rental Seven,’ and the front basket's right side is slightly bent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show the photo, blue color, Rental Seven tag and bent basket as identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真と特徴を確認します。鍵はかけていましたか。また、貸した宿には連絡しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the photo and features. Was it locked, and have you contacted the lodging that lent it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後輪の鍵をかけ、鍵は手元にあります。宿にはまだ連絡していないので、ここから電話してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 施錠と鍵の所持を報告し宿に電話する許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I locked the rear wheel and have the key. I haven't contacted the lodging yet; may I phone them from here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, report locking and possession of the key, and ask permission to call the lodging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。宿が持っている車体番号や登録の情報も確認してください。状況を聞き、必要な届け出についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Ask for the bicycle number and registration information they hold too. We'll hear the situation and explain necessary reports.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宿に、なくなった場所と時刻を伝え、車体番号が分かる書類を用意してもらいます。似た自転車には触りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宿へ場所と時刻を伝え車体番号の書類を依頼し別車体には触らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell the lodging the place and time it went missing, and ask them to prepare a document showing the bicycle number. I won't touch the similar bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, tell the lodging the place and time, request bicycle-number documents, and say you won't touch the other bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お電話の後で確認できた情報をお知らせください。この席で続けてお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: After your call, tell us the information you confirmed. We'll continue talking at this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大切な提出書類なのですね。封をする前に、先方が指定した送り方の説明を一緒に確認しましょう。案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: These are important submission documents. Before sealing, let's check the recipient's required shipping method together. Do you have the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内には「記録の残る方法で」とだけ書いてあります。追跡できれば、その条件を満たすのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録の残る方法という指定を示し追跡だけでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They only say a method with a record. Does tracking alone meet that condition?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show the requirement for a method leaving records and ask whether tracking alone is enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追跡の有無だけでは、提出先が求める条件を判断できません。差し出した記録なのか、受け取った記録なのかを確かめていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tracking alone doesn't establish the recipient's conditions. Please check whether they need a record of sending or of receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 差し出した記録と、相手が受け取った記録は別なのですね。提出先に何と聞けば伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出と受取の記録の違いを復唱して提出先への尋ね方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: A sending record and a record of the other party receiving it are different. How should I ask the recipient to make it clear?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, repeat the difference between sending and receipt records and ask how to question the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 「必要なのは差し出したことの記録ですか、それとも配達や受け取りの記録ですか」とお尋ねになるとよいと思います。期限もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could ask, ‘Do you need a record that I sent it, or a record of delivery or receipt?’ Is there a deadline too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金曜日までとありますが、消印でよいのか、金曜日に届く必要があるのかも書かれていません。そこも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金曜日という期限の消印か必着かも確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says by Friday, but not whether a postmark is enough or it must arrive Friday. I'll check that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will also check whether Friday is a postmark deadline or an arrival deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。到着が必要な場合でも、今ここで金曜日の到着をお約束することはできません。今日は発送をお待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Even if arrival is required, we can't promise Friday arrival here now. Would you wait to send it today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 条件が曖昧なまま送るのは避けたいので、今日は持ち帰ります。封をする前に、宛先も提出先の案内と照合しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件確認まで発送せず持ち帰り封をする前に宛先も照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't want to send with unclear conditions, so I'll take it home today. Before sealing, I'll also compare the address with the recipient's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you won't send until conditions are checked, will take it home and compare the address before sealing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。再来される際は、提出先に確認した条件と、宛先を確かめた封筒をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. When you return, bring the recipient's confirmed conditions and the envelope with the address checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要な記録と期限の数え方を提出先に確認し、回答をメモして封筒と一緒に持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要な記録と期限の回答をメモして封筒と再持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the recipient what records are needed and how the deadline is counted, note the reply, and bring it with the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will note the reply about required records and deadline interpretation and return with the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それから条件に合う取扱いを一緒に確認しましょう。書類をお返しします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll check handling that fits the conditions together. Here are your documents back. Have a safe journey home.
